criteria.text: User Action: User navigates to their chore preferences. Expected System Behavior: Displays the household’s chores, each with an option to mark it as preferred.
User Action: User marks or unmarks chores as preferred and saves. Expected System Behavior: The preferences are saved, and a confirmation message is displayed.
User Action: A housemate assigns a chore. Expected System Behavior: Housemates who prefer that chore are shown as preferring it in the assignment options.
Error Condition: The household has no chores yet. Expected message: “No chores to choose from yet.”
Error Condition: The preferences fail to save. Expected message: The system displays an error message and provides an option to try saving again.
